title: sdks: unify auth/retries + streaming ergonomics + parity fixes (v1.63.1)
author: Maya Patel
description:
Summary: This PR consolidates several cross-SDK improvements required for parity ahead of the 1.63.1 SDK rollouts. Key focus areas: unified auth and retry behavior, streaming API ergonomics in Python/TypeScript/Go, small parity fixes for option names and default values, and version bumps + changelog updates. Motivation: customers and internal teams reported inconsistent retry surface and streaming ergonomics across SDKs which causes integration friction and surprising behavior under transient network failures. This PR makes the behavior consistent, improves developer ergonomics for streams, and prepares the SDKs for a coordinated patch release.

What changed (high-level):
- Unified auth token refresh flow across Python/TS/Go SDKs: centralize token refresh logic, add a short-circuit path for static API keys, and harmonize default credential TTL handling.
- Standardized retries/backoff configuration: introduce shared retry conf keys (max_retries, initial_backoff_ms, max_backoff_ms, jitter) and consistent defaults (max_retries=3, initial_backoff_ms=100, max_backoff_ms=2000).
- Streaming ergonomics:
  - Python: streaming client now exposes an async iterator (AsyncStreamingResponse) and simpler sync iterator for users using threads; added clearer docs and examples.
  - TypeScript: switch to an EventEmitter-compatible stream with typed payloads and an easy-to-use once() helper for single-response flows.
  - Go: expose a typed channel-based stream and helper CloseWithErr to propagate server-side errors cleanly.
- Parity fixes: align option names (stream_timeout -> stream_timeout_ms, retry_delay -> initial_backoff_ms), correct a discrepancy in embeddings.create parameter name (embedding_dim -> dimension) and ensure default timeout semantics match other SDKs.
- Version bumps and changelogs: bump python to 1.63.1, typescript to 1.63.1, go to v1.63.1; update CHANGELOGs and release notes.

Testing and CI: Updated unit and integration tests for all three SDKs. Added new flaky test guard to exclude a known ephemeral GRPC race on macOS CI. Local + CI runs: all checks passed after one round of fixes for a streaming race condition in python tests.

Rollout and migration notes: This is backward-compatible for most users; however, any users relying on the old option names must update to the new keys or use the compatibility aliases that are still present for this patch release. See release_notes for details.

References: Linear ENG-1245 (SDK parity), ENG-1287 (streaming ergonomics), SUP-442 incident for auth refresh failures.

release_notes:
- SDKs: unified auth token refresh and retry configuration across Python/TypeScript/Go.
- Streaming: improved ergonomics (Python async iterator, TS EventEmitter, Go channel API) and clearer examples.
- Parity: option name alignments and fixes for embeddings parameter naming.
- Versions: bumped to 1.63.1 (python/ts) and v1.63.1 (go).
Migration: compatibility aliases kept for old option names for one release; update clients to new keys (stream_timeout_ms, initial_backoff_ms, dimension).
notes_for_release_manager: Coordination required: publish python wheel, npm package, and go module in quick succession to keep parity. Docs site should have streaming examples updated at the same time. Notify integrations and partners about deprecated option aliases and removal plan (remove in v1.64.0).
